intent: Central map from Composa editor semantics (layer types, layout, spacing, alignment, typography, sizing, media) to their Lucide glyph, so every inspector field and panel shows one consistent icon.

tokens.note: No token bindings. Exports return bare LucideIcon component references; size, stroke, and color are applied by the consumer that renders them.

a11y.role: none — this module renders no DOM. `composaIconSemantics` is a semantic→LucideIcon map and `iconForSemantic(semantic)` returns the icon component for a semantic.
a11y.note: The resolved icon is decorative; the consumer that renders it owns aria-label / aria-hidden and any interactive role.

code.import: import { iconForSemantic, composaIconSemantics, type ComposaIconSemantic } from '@composa/ui'
